name: E09_3_guttersnipe_each_opponent_takes_two
notes: G2 verifier, batch E. Printed: 'Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this creature deals 2 damage to each opponent.' A three-player game. Seat 0 casts Opt (an instant): each of its two opponents, seats 1 and 2, takes 2 damage (18 each). Seat 0 takes none.
